quotes.quote: It looks like we are much better in the race than in qualifying, this for sure compared to Mercedes. But I don't know if they've shown all the pace that they had. But on my side, it's been quite a poor race in terms of performance. I was quite slow all race long. The car felt very strange in general. So I don't think I was in the right window of the setup.
quotes.context: Race performance and setup issues

quotes.quote: Tough of course trying to learn on the go and understand things. Difficult, not an easy thing to try and understand and to maximize but I think we learned through the race. We clearly did because you know the beginning of the race we were pretty slow but yeah comparing to Max comparing to the cars ahead not even close. So yeah we have a lot of things to look into to try and understand.
quotes.context: Learning and pace compared to teammate

quotes.quote: It was okay. Of course we also have quite a bit more pace than the midfield. So I just needed to clear that clean which we did. Learned a lot of course also with the battles and how to use the battery and stuff. The two hard compounds today didn't really work for us. So a lot of degradation lot of graining and that made me then of course do a two stop.
quotes.context: Race pace and tire strategy

quotes.quote: It's a special feeling to start off the new regs like this. It's a great result for the entire team, you know, best of the rest. Of course, we benefited from a few retirements from people ahead of us, but regardless, those are points and we're going to take every one of them.
quotes.context: Scoring points on debut

quotes.quote: I was supposed to get in the points after the mega first lap that we did. We moved forward a massive amount, it was definitely awesome the way we launched. But after that, the pace was very bad, which was a big surprise. It's just flashback of last year really. We don't seem to have the same cars, myself and Ollie.
quotes.context: Strong start but poor race pace

quotes.quote: Obviously, you need pace to make progress and we didn't have it today. Honestly, that was the race. It felt like we were about half a second to a second off the midfield, which is quite tough. Struggled a lot with graining today and then yeah, just not where we want to be.
quotes.context: Lack of pace in race

quotes.quote: That was a big win with this huge regulation change. This has been the best result that we could aim for. I think we have a lot of information to go through, a lot of procedure to tidy up. Unfortunately in Formula 1, there is no time, so we need to do bigger steps as soon as possible to be able to move forwards.
quotes.context: New team result and development needs

quotes.quote: I think that was the best part of the race for sure, the start. Then we fall back a little bit to our natural position and then we have an alarm on the car. We have to stop the car once. I think we cleared that alarm. We had another problem. We have to retire for the second time. So it was a little bit of an on-off day.
quotes.context: Race retirement with technical issues

quotes.quote: You know I've developed some sort of technical problem on the laps to grid and just you know made it there but then yeah something we couldn't fix quickly. Very unfortunate obviously not to make the start at all, missing out on learning. But on the bright side, points for the team. Gabby got P9 in the bank.
quotes.context: Pre-race technical problem prevented start

quotes.quote: Just solid day, no mistakes, clean, just sort of the way I wanted to start the season. I think we knew we had a fast car beneath us. I don't think we ever anticipated it to be this fast.
quotes.context: Reflecting on strong qualifying performance

quotes.quote: I just like to make my life difficult. Even Q3, I went off in lap one, found myself with no lap on the board, and today the heroes were the mechanics. I just cannot thank them enough.
quotes.context: Praising mechanics after Q3 incident

quotes.quote: I'm very happy. Honestly, when I crossed the line, I knew there was a good lap, maybe top three, which it was. It's a perfect start to my Red Bull career.
quotes.context: Celebrating first Red Bull qualifying session

quotes.quote: This morning I did not expect what they've shown and I think there were a lot more turned down than what everybody thought in the paddock. It's very surprising, but at the same time, we can only respect what they've done with their engine.
quotes.context: Commenting on Mercedes' surprising pace

quotes.quote: I think it's about where we thought we would be. Obviously behind the two Mercedes, it's pretty close. Obviously, we need to find a bit of time because the sandbags well and truly got dropped out.
quotes.context: Assessing McLaren's qualifying position

quotes.quote: I just had some damage on the front wing, which certainly didn't help from that massive piece of debris that I hit. I don't know how much that cost me, but it certainly cost me a chance for P3.
quotes.context: Explaining front wing damage impact

quotes.quote: The whole weekend was looking good up until Q2. Then we went into Q2 and we had some problems with our engine. So we ended up having to come in. That put a lot of pressure on us.
quotes.context: Describing engine issues in Q2

quotes.quote: All weekend we've been quite competitive. I was trying to not get too excited after yesterday because we didn't know if things were going to change. The team had done a phenomenal job. It's really impressive to have two cars in Q3 especially from where we were in Bahrain.
quotes.context: Pleased with Haas Q3 performance

quotes.quote: In the middle of the inlap, some stuff started to fail and we still have to analyze exactly what happened there. Just a shame to not be able to take part of the Q3 that was well deserved from the team.
quotes.context: Disappointed after missing Q3 opportunity

quotes.quote: It was a tricky qual. My Q1 we had some issues on the power unit. It wasn't quite behaving as we expected or needed it to. I had one lap in Q2 where everything more or less worked as it should and put in a good lap.
quotes.context: Managing power unit issues in qualifying

quotes.quote: I'm so proud of the team and the collective effort that has been made to get the car to where it is today to confirm our feelings in Bahrain which were that we had a solid baseline. It's tough and it hurts to miss out by such a small margin.
quotes.context: Missing Q3 by small margin

quotes.quote: I think we had more in hands. Basically the team told me that I had some potential loss to the downforce of the car on the rear and it correlate with my feeling. I really had a lot of instability under that last run.
quotes.context: Explaining downforce loss affecting performance

quotes.quote: I would say it improved but not enough. Obviously I think we all disappointed. We want much more than that and it's just not good enough. I'm pretty happy with the laps I put out there. I managed to be right at the limit of the car.
quotes.context: Disappointed with overall Alpine performance

quotes.quote: I think it was a better result than we expected going into the weekend and was able to beat basically one of the other midfield cars. It's been a difficult weekend. We've been on the back foot. Obviously Carlos missing out on a lot of running.
quotes.context: Limited running affecting Williams weekend

quotes.quote: It's been tough. I think so far it hasn't been easy or what we were expecting in Bahrain. I think in Bahrain we were hoping to be closer to Q3 and be close to that fight but it's been hard.
quotes.context: Struggling to match Bahrain expectations

quotes.quote: We could all bet that we were not able to go through Q1 and we nearly made it. I think definitely progress since yesterday we didn't touch the car much to be honest. That tells me that the potential is huge.
quotes.context: Finding progress without car changes

quotes.quote: It's been a very tricky weekend up to qualifying. We haven't been able to get any laps in a lot of issues. I'm very pleased with the job the team has done operationally.
quotes.context: Praising team despite limited running

quotes.quote: You just hit the brakes and suddenly the rear axle just completely locked out of the blue. I don't know why that happened or how it happened. I've never experienced something like that before in my career.
quotes.context: Describing unusual brake failure crash

quotes.quote: We had an ERS package issue and we didn't manage to solve it in time for quali. So no laps on FP2, no laps in FP3, no laps in Q1. Very disappointing first weekend with this first set of regulations.
quotes.context: Missing entire qualifying due to issues

quotes.quote: I achieved one of my dreams which was to win the race and then my next one of course is to win the world championship. But the road is still long and George is super strong and it's going to take a lot to beat him. I'm super happy my dad is with me today because he could assist my first race win.
quotes.context: Celebrating his first F1 race win

quotes.quote: Race start Ferrari got the upper hand of us, safety car restart they got the upper hand of us and unfortunately that hindered my chances of going for victory. Kimmy did a great job. Ferrari once again, three races down, three races they've made our life pretty awkward in those opening laps.
quotes.context: Reflecting on missing victory to teammate

quotes.quote: It was such a tough battle, just so hard out there. It's really hard to hold the Mercedes off. It was impossible actually. They were just so quick on the straight. So we really got to step up. I think the car is good enough. We just need more power on the straights.
quotes.context: Discussing difficulty racing against Mercedes pace

quotes.quote: I actually really enjoyed the race. I'm of course a little bit disappointed to lose out on the podium, but on the other side I'm happy for Lewis and I think he deserves it more than I do on a weekend like this where he's been more on top of things than me and just have been stronger since FP1 to now.
quotes.context: Commenting on missing podium to teammate

quotes.quote: Ocon got out my inside there on turn 13 and then lost the car right in front of me and I was kind of deer in the headlights. I had no idea what to do. I went left. At the end, I probably should have gone right. I went back very far, managed to overtake some cars again. Luckily the safety car timing was good.
quotes.context: Describing incident with Ocon at turn 13

quotes.quote: I have one side of me who is really pleased with the sixth place. Another side deep inside me that is pretty upset because I knew this fifth place was ours like before the safety car. I was comfortably in P5 and we had the pace, we were faster than Bearman.
quotes.context: Mixed feelings about P6 finish

quotes.quote: Pretty happy with the result. I don't think we really expected it to be honest. The safety car was the worst time safety car ever as well. We just boxed and come back out and so to be honest I thought the race was pretty much over. But the pace was good in the end.
quotes.context: Pleased with unexpected P7 result

quotes.quote: I didn't see that coming. The rear snapped out so fast. It's a shame because we had a good start. Still somehow we got quite lucky with some cars having issues and us ending up in the points when clearly our pace was not great the whole weekend.
quotes.context: Discussing spin and lucky points finish

quotes.quote: You can call it mini win, mini victory for us. Just another mega start. Got ourselves into the points early on and then it was all about managing that one stop to the end. Our pace is still not good enough for points, but by doing everything else well we managed to get called home top nine.
quotes.context: Pleased with points despite lacking pace

quotes.quote: It's my fault. I did a mistake, I misjudged it. I'm glad that Franco still got a point because he drove a very good race. We did good fights all the way until then. It's a shame it ended like this. I deserve the penalty today, it's very clear.
quotes.context: Taking responsibility for contact with Colapinto

quotes.quote: That was fully on me. I saw the gap and I went for it but obviously VR didn't had nowhere to go. So I was over optimistic. So full apologies on that one to Valtteri and the team. I spun, I lost a lot of track time.
quotes.context: Apologizing for incident with teammate Bottas

quotes.quote: First race of the season for me so just valuable to get that experience, to get the laps in, learn about the energy management and all these things. Obviously a lot to process, to take in now. Whilst it was obviously not successful and facing a lot of problems, it's useful.
quotes.context: Reflecting on first race experience

quotes.quote: Wasn't a very good race. Lap one was decent. The timing of the safety car was a bit unfortunate for us. If we'd pitted onto the medium we wouldn't have been able to go to the end so we're kind of forced to stay on the hard. Not an easy weekend, too many mistakes on my side.
quotes.context: Disappointed with race performance and mistakes

quotes.quote: Bit of a contact but these things happen. I didn't see him there and actually didn't really have any space on the outside. Yeah we spoke already, all good. I'm just glad we both finished. Honestly really proud of everyone, second race ever for us in Formula 1 and we got P3. It's not bad.
quotes.context: Discussing contact and team's P3 finish

quotes.quote: Same problem as yesterday in the start. So we lost again. Then tried to find my way forward but again the same problems as in the sprint where there was just a lot of deg, a lot of graining on the tires. Then we had to retire the car with the EOS cooling issues.
quotes.context: Explaining start problems and retirement

quotes.quote: I just turned into turn one and everything switched off. So I don't know what the issue was, if it was engine, battery, something electronic. It was an electrical problem on the power unit. Very unfortunate to both have issues. Just an issue that's not letting us even start the car.
quotes.context: Describing power unit failure at race start

quotes.quote: Some form of hydraulic issue to be honest with you. Just a huge list of issues this weekend. We don't really understand, we need to do better as a team. It's frustrating but silver lining, Carlos got a couple points which is important for us.
quotes.context: Discussing hydraulic failure and team struggles

quotes.quote: I went out on track, I had no power. I was stuck in first gear. I almost span off because the rear tires locked up. The car stopped, it then restarted and I was stuck in I couldn't change gear again. Front wing broke in Q2, so I did no lap in Q2. So it was just absolutely carnage. And I was just really happy just to get an opportunity to do a lap.
quotes.context: Technical issues during qualifying session

quotes.quote: I do take it with a pinch of salt cuz I think George didn't really get a consistent bunch of runs. And I think maybe he would have been a little bit quicker had he had consistent runs, but either way, I'll we'll take it. And I think we have improved the car a tiny bit.
quotes.context: Comparing his qualifying performance to Russell

quotes.quote: Both runs were pretty similar. I think I made a big mistake on my first lap in the final corner, which cost me maybe a tenth. And maybe a tenth is a position, but it's very close to the Ferraris. It's tough because you think could we have got another tenth and a half out of it or something? I think that was in it today. So just didn't quite hook it up.
quotes.context: Reflecting on his qualifying performance

quotes.quote: I mean it's the same. I mean we changed the whole car and it makes zero difference. I have no balance. So you can't even lap after lap get a bit of a reference because it's just all over the place and it's incredibly difficult to drive.
quotes.context: Struggling with car balance in qualifying

quotes.quote: Yesterday we really struggled to understand the lack of performance compared to Pierre and Norris's cars and the team was really good to be honest, engineers, Pierre, everyone was really positive in helping me to understand the issues and what we were lacking in my car. The team gave me those bits and pieces of performance that we found that were not in a good place in my car and today it performed a lot better.
quotes.context: Explaining improved performance after struggling previously

quotes.quote: For me it was actually first qualifying session without issues. So very straightforward. Felt like I got the most out of the package, which is always a good feeling, but also now we see where we are. So now it's we still got work to do with the reliability, but of course performance.
quotes.context: Clean qualifying session after reliability issues

quotes.quote: I was very annoyed with the start. I really need to find a way to do good starts because to be fair the whole weekend it looks like we were doing a good job and the start felt all strong but then in the race I don't know I think I just did a mistake and then obviously put me in a really bad position. Pace was super super strong to be fair and of course we were lucky with the outcome of the safety car even though in the medium we had a really strong pace.
quotes.context: Discussing his start mistake and race win

quotes.quote: I think very happy. I think we executed everything we could have today. I think to be honest with you, even without the safety car, I think Kimmy was going to be hard to beat Kimmy. It's been a tough start to the year and to come out with the P2 and feeling like we had a chance of a win, it's pretty special at this point.
quotes.context: Reflecting on his P2 finish

quotes.quote: Of course, I'm not over the moon because it's only a P3, but considering everything, we've been quite unlucky with the safety car, which is okay. Then we came back to the podium, which was good. And to keep that third place in the end wasn't an easy task. On a track which historically has been extremely difficult to overtake, we've still seen some overtakes with these cars.
quotes.context: Discussing his P3 podium finish

quotes.quote: It was a good start anyway. I think the pace was good. I think honestly like I think we were decent. Clearly, the Mercedes was still another level, but we could have a nice race with the Ferraris. As soon as I had clean air, which I had on two laps of the whole race, the last lap and one lap in the middle, the car really came alive quite a bit more.
quotes.context: Analyzing his race pace and clean air performance

quotes.quote: I was struggling with power the whole race so no not particularly. Pretty terrible weekend in general to get result like that. But you know there are some points there so take it.
quotes.context: Reflecting on his P6 finish and struggles

quotes.quote: I'm very happy. It was a long intense race especially after the safety car. The first part of the race was pretty good and I felt comfortable. I had a bit of a gap with him, but I knew at the moment there's always a safety car at some point, so I wasn't getting too comfortable. Second part of the race, this guy just would not leave my heels all the way through.
quotes.context: Describing the intensity of his race

quotes.quote: At least my start was a little bit better. I didn't lose too many positions. I think with Pier were very closely matched maybe on pure pace we're a tiny bit faster but that's easy to say now. It was just very hard to pass. I mean I could pass but then I would get repassed straight away because my battery would be empty.
quotes.context: Discussing overtaking difficulties and battery management

quotes.quote: From where we started the doubts we had with obviously the balance we ended quali with yesterday I think we've done a pretty good job to rebalance the car and have a strong race. We got very lucky with the safety car today. Obviously a good result. We'll take the points and try and improve things going forward.
quotes.context: Reflecting on car balance improvements and race result

quotes.quote: First of all glad that Olie is okay but unfortunately three races out of three races bad timing with the safety car. We lost two positions during that. We had a decent start. Everything was going normal and then we lost to Gabby and to Liam.
quotes.context: Discussing bad safety car timing and lost positions

quotes.quote: Just a really poor start losing five positions I believe which obviously yeah is quite compromising for the rest of the race being in quite obviously heavy traffic. It's been interesting and fun but also frustrating at times when you make a great move but then the next straight obviously you're a sitting duck and you get repassed.
quotes.context: Explaining his poor start and overtaking frustrations

quotes.quote: I had a good start. I was fighting Pier just like I wanted to do on lap one and I got run out of battery very early on the finish straight and I started to be overtaken by everyone every lap and trying to recover energy. So, I was just stuck for a while.
quotes.context: Describing early battery issues in the race

quotes.quote: I think the start was not great, but we knew it was something we need to work on in the team. For me and Nico, we have been struggling a lot since race one. We are working on it. The team is working hard on that. We need just need time to put things in place.
quotes.context: Discussing ongoing start procedure problems

quotes.quote: Started P10 and I think I was running P8 after a lap or two. There was a few things I could have managed better on the energy side in the battle with Max and Esteban on that first in. So I lost those two places there. The pit stop was a bit slow so I lost the place to Esteban and then the safety car came out.
quotes.context: Analyzing his energy management and lost positions

quotes.quote: We had a very solid race. We maximized everything. Actually, we improved the car compared to Friday and we were bit closer to the midfield than what we were expecting to be. We were mixing it up with Franco, Hulk, and Lindblad but unfortunately it was just not quite enough to get ourselves in the fight.
quotes.context: Discussing car improvements and midfield battle

quotes.quote: I'm glad he's fine to be honest. It's the first thing I asked to the team because it was a really big one. I saw him spinning on the grass and then I knew it was a very hard hit. It was just a long day today. Generally not what we wanted. It was a difficult weekend overall.
quotes.context: Reacting to crash and difficult weekend

quotes.quote: Good start then stuck behind Liam for the whole stint on mediums tried to undercut did it but then the safety car really punished us finished P9. I think we made some good progress it's been our strongest race. Yesterday we had some issues with the deployment and it seems like today we were on top of it.
quotes.context: Describing his P9 finish and progress made

quotes.quote: Definitely there are many boxes to tick in the team and yeah today I think completing the first race distance gave the team good information good data that we need to analyze and to improve. The pace was not there in any session on the weekend and was not there in the race either so yeah we need to improve in many areas.
quotes.context: Reflecting on completing race distance for data

quotes.quote: Good thing again you know finish with both cars unlike some others so that's good and again from this weekend I think we can take a lot. We can learn a lot. But performance I think for Czecho was actually okay. I was lacking quite a bit of performance. I really challenged today to struggle to challenge the Aston today.
quotes.context: Discussing team reliability and his performance struggles

quotes.quote: I think trying to understand the issues from yesterday not sure if we understand them still. So we'll keep looking into it and then at the same time, why not do a bit of pit stop practice and a bit of front wing testing. So yeah, that's what we could do today.
quotes.context: Explaining testing activities during the race

quotes.quote: I think it's a water pressure issue. I was having a fun race with Fernando in our own little championship, our own Aston Martin championship. I was enjoying the race even though we were slow and we were fighting for the last positions. Suzuka it's always a nice track to drive.
quotes.context: Discussing his DNF and battle with Fernando

quotes.quote: Everything good. First of all, I'm absolutely fine. It was a scary moment that happened out there but everything is okay which is the main thing. Car is a bit worse for wear but we have a month now to reset and come back. I can only apologize from the bottom of my heart to the team for that because it's a lot of work for them.
quotes.context: Apologizing after his crash

quotes.quote: We made a small adjustment to the rear suspension going into qualifying and it's tiny and suddenly the car just was transformed for the worse and then I started getting these weird vibrations from the rear.
quotes.context: Explaining uncomfortable qualifying performance

quotes.quote: I just got used to it. Drove around it. I could then adjust the front wing to compensate, but the car was just totally out of balance from the entry of the corners to the mid corner because the rear was moving around on the entry.
quotes.context: Describing how he adapted during qualifying

quotes.quote: To be ahead of one of the Ferraris after the weekend I've had, I think is pretty happy with that. It's just been difficult, watching the TV more than driving in the car this weekend.
quotes.context: Reflecting on limited track time

quotes.quote: We did a good job with the setup. The car was feeling pretty decent, just we're obviously lacking a lot of speed in the middle sector and a little bit in the last sector, but yeah, part of it is power and deployment, which is quite important here.
quotes.context: Discussing car performance and deficits

quotes.quote: Two tenths is quite a big margin. I don't think we had that in the tank today. I'm pretty happy with the job that we've done on our side. Just looking at ourselves, I think it was pretty positive the way we've built the weekend.
quotes.context: Assessment of qualifying gap to pole

quotes.quote: We had an issue with the front wing in Q2, and when we changed it for a new one, we completely lost balance running a different wing than we'd run this weekend.
quotes.context: Explaining front wing issue in Q2

quotes.quote: Obviously as a team I think we've been a bit more competitive in low fuel this weekend and with a very good lap in Q1 I managed to sneak through into Q2 beating I think it was Franco at the time on quicker cars.
quotes.context: Pleased with personal performance despite position

quotes.quote: We've been having a lot of issues with deployment. We keep losing around three tenths to half a second every lap on deployment, something that we haven't been able to come on top of.
quotes.context: Describing ongoing deployment issues

quotes.quote: I'm very happy for the team. Since lap one, literally, turn one, everything felt better. It felt a little bit more like last year, just having some confidence in the car, and I felt that. A nice start to the weekend, probably better than we're expecting, honestly.
quotes.context: Reacting to upgrades performing well

quotes.quote: The car had great potential today, which was really nice to see. I think it was a bit of a surprise for us on the soft. My lap in SQ3 didn't feel the best, so to end up third is a good effort.
quotes.context: Reflecting on P3 in sprint qualifying

quotes.quote: We kind of expected that situation where Mercedes is probably still the car to beat. McLaren did a very big step forward. On our side, we struggled with tires. Medium were working very well. On the soft, it wasn't a nice feeling.
quotes.context: Discussing tire struggles and competitor performance

quotes.quote: It feels more together. Last year races we were like over a second behind. I would say we have almost half that gap now. We're still very weak in the first sector, which is mainly high-speed.
quotes.context: Assessing Williams' improvement over last year

quotes.quote: Pretty surprised in how big a jump McLaren and Ferrari have made. That's pretty damn impressive. We knew they'd close the gap, but they've been quicker than us. My side have been struggling today.
quotes.context: Surprised by McLaren and Ferrari's pace

quotes.quote: I thought we'd be stronger than we were today. I have to do some work overnight to try and figure out why we're not that quick. I was hopeful coming in positive that we're going to be much higher, but not meant to be.
quotes.context: Disappointed with qualifying performance

quotes.quote: I'm happy because we turned around something that was quite tough and it took us a while to understand. We are finally getting in the rhythm and understanding some of the pace that we lacked, doing good laps all day in a track that I know.
quotes.context: Happy with turnaround after difficult period

quotes.quote: Got through Q2 which is a start but then to be second off I don't know why. I've never been more than a tenth off so far this year when it mattered. It's been very difficult since this morning, having a lot of wheel spin.
quotes.context: Struggling with unexplained pace deficit

quotes.quote: Obviously a bit disappointed that we were not able to go through. It was so close to go to Q3. The lap was not too bad but a few things here and there that could have done better.
quotes.context: Narrowly missing Q3 advancement

quotes.quote: Shame because I felt like today we could have done Q3 if everything went perfect but at the same time happy because the FP1 we had was a big mess. I had a big problem, lost half an hour in the garage.
quotes.context: Mixed feelings after messy FP1

quotes.quote: It's the hottest conditions that we've driven this car and it's posing a few challenges. It's been challenging to put on the limit, a bit unpredictable on the limit and with the walls close as well, it's tough to go for a full-in quali lap when you don't fully have the car underneath you.
quotes.context: Struggling with car balance in heat

quotes.quote: Better for sure. I think that's like a genuine Q2 for us. I'm happy with that. I think that's progress from the team. Upgrades are working. Exploring different philosophies today, we've learned a lot now.
quotes.context: Pleased with Q2 result and upgrades

quotes.quote: Just the step we expected, so a bit of a step in a good direction. I've been more performing, fighting to get into SQ2, especially given the fact that on my side of the garage, we've been having a lot of issues with energy management on the out lap and the push lap.
quotes.context: Satisfied with expected progress despite issues

quotes.quote: We struggled a lot. I had a lot of issues in P1, so just getting through to Q2 was good. To be honest with myself, I'm just happy to have gotten into SQ2 because I was having a very difficult session in FP1.
quotes.context: Happy to reach SQ2 after difficult FP1

quotes.quote: It was a series of bad events. Had a little bit misplaced on the garage exit and ended up a lot further back on track, didn't have a very good out lap and then I had a big flat spot in turn one and destroyed the tire.
quotes.context: Explaining elimination from Q1

quotes.quote: It's been a rough day. It's been an untidy FP1. We had deployment issues and we didn't have a clear low fuel running. We didn't have a great car underneath us. It's been probably the most difficult day of the year so far.
quotes.context: Describing difficult day with multiple issues

quotes.quote: We progress, but we just having too many issues at the moment. I only managed to do one lap in qualifying. We've lost a lot of track time in practice. We keep having these issues that we really have to, I think that's priority number one at the moment to be able to maximize the package.
quotes.context: Frustrated by reliability issues limiting running

quotes.quote: The car feels better. We definitely gained some load, especially high to medium speed. Still obviously need to make further steps, but at least the feeling is better and heading in the right direction. Vibrations were better.
quotes.context: Positive about car feeling and direction

quotes.quote: We seem quick, I seem comfortable from the beginning. My pace was good. Of course I had clean air, which always helps. The car performed well. Another one-two for the team, and it's good for everyone back in our base to kind of see those things again.
quotes.context: Reflecting on Ferrari's sprint one-two finish

quotes.quote: Especially in qualifying we need to do a step forward. In the race we are strong, we brought some very strong upgrades, and we are much closer to where we want to be, but in qualifying we are always on the back foot. I think it's more power unit than anything, and especially coming Q3 Mercedes find something that we don't quite find just yet.
quotes.context: Discussing Ferrari's qualifying versus race pace

quotes.quote: It feels challenging for everyone out there. Miami is a very low grip circuit. The cars are sliding around a lot. It's just a track I've never really liked in terms of how you have to drive the cars. It's one I struggle at. It's definitely one my teammate excels at.
quotes.context: Struggling with Miami circuit characteristics

quotes.quote: Overall it was a lot more positive. We're finally battling a bit more with the cars that we want to battle. Even considering all the issues that I had in the start again, something went wrong. And then on the end of the first lap I had no battery release out of the last corner, so that's why I got passed.
quotes.context: Explaining start issues but positive pace

quotes.quote: The drop was good and on my side I think for once I did everything right, so it was a shame to again have a really bad start because then just compromise the race. We're struggling a little bit this weekend, but pace was not too bad at the end.
quotes.context: Frustrated by another poor start

quotes.quote: As Max showed, he was fighting up there. On my side obviously had a terrible start again, so we really need to fix that because it's just wasting our pace and then we have to fight back and otherwise we would have been in the points comfortably.
quotes.context: Addressing repeated start problems

quotes.quote: It was tough. Just a big lack of rear grip and a lot of sliding, pressures are really really high on the rear and creates a lot of sliding but traction no grip on the rear axle, so we need to try to keep working for qualifying now.
quotes.context: Struggling with rear grip issues

quotes.quote: That was our pace. It was very difficult to catch the cars ahead. It was Isack and a few opens, they are quite strong, they put us 10 second gap. I stabilized in a pace that I was comfortable in. It was a bit of a boring race, only lap one was quite fun.
quotes.context: Managing pace between faster and slower cars

quotes.quote: I think we are struggling a little bit with pace. We were together with Ollie trying to catch Gabi, but unfortunately he was a bit too fast for us. So we need to try and see if we can improve the situation for this afternoon.
quotes.context: Unable to catch Bortoleto ahead

quotes.quote: I was just really struggling with the rear axle since very early on, particularly in high speed, and then obviously this track has so many traction zones and I was really struggling. It was a fight trying to stay on track actually.
quotes.context: Major rear axle handling issues

quotes.quote: We're certainly a bit closer and a bit more competitive this weekend. A bit disappointed because we didn't nail the qualifying with the energy yesterday, we didn't nail the start which has been my strongest point of the year. But on the pace side, as soon as we got cleaner we managed to catch up the Haas and the Audis which 5 weeks ago was impossible.
quotes.context: Progress shown despite operational mistakes

quotes.quote: The first probably six or seven laps we had an issue with power so I just keep getting overtaken down the straight between 16 and 17, so I'd lose a place every lap. And then we finally fixed it and once we fixed it it was actually not too bad.
quotes.context: Early power issue costing positions

quotes.quote: We were racing in the first couple of laps making some moves but we were on the hard tire and I think we paid a very high price. We over slide, we thought that was going to be better but it wasn't. We were the only car actually on the hard so we learn a lot of that.
quotes.context: Hard tire strategy didn't work out

quotes.quote: We improved the vibrations a bit since Japan. Some things to work on, we'll try and make it better for the qualifying.
quotes.context: Brief assessment of sprint performance

quotes.quote: I think we were making a good recovery, we were moving up the field and then we caught up to the midfield pack. We're trying to learn the upgrade package. I think we've noticed something from yesterday that's not quite right on the car.
quotes.context: Learning new upgrades during recovery drive

quotes.quote: It was really tricky sprint for me. Really struggling with pace big time. It's sliding around from lap one really. So we got to figure out what's what's going on. Something I don't think is right.
quotes.context: Major pace struggles throughout sprint

quotes.quote: I'm very happy with the pole. It was a good way to end the day after a difficult spring race and yeah, just going to enjoy the evening now. Going to look at some data, especially starts, and also race.
quotes.context: Reaction to taking pole position

quotes.quote: Last qualifying I was not even in Q3, so for us this is an unbelievable turnaround. The car is finally also more together. It has better performance and also I feel more in control of the car where before I felt like a passenger in it.
quotes.context: Performance improvement and qualifying second

quotes.quote: Unfortunately, it was if anything a little bit worse compared to yesterday. I don't think we did an amazing job at anticipating what it was going to feel like for qualifying and the grip getting higher as well.
quotes.context: Disappointment with qualifying performance

quotes.quote: I think the weird thing is how much pace we lost from yesterday to today really. It was just a lot trickier, much more messy session from our side as a team. Myself included, so some things to understand.
quotes.context: Loss of pace from practice

quotes.quote: It was never the most you can do and I think P3 was on the cards, but yeah, it's just a track I've always struggled with. Last year Kimi was pole and I was P5 and today he's pole and I'm P5, so it's not really the major cause for concern.
quotes.context: Fifth place qualifying result comparison

quotes.quote: We changed the car going into qualifying and it was much, much better. In hindsight I wish we started with the car like that. That's where Charles started. The car was night and day different, so I was basically learning through the session.
quotes.context: Setup changes during qualifying

quotes.quote: I'm very pleased with the performance but with the effort that the engineers, mechanics have done to also turn around the performance from Suzuka into a double Q3 here in Miami.
quotes.context: Team performance and double Q3

quotes.quote: There's a bit of frustration because on my side in Q3 I didn't deliver any good laps. There's a lot of lap time left. And on the other hand, we are struggling with power down the straight.
quotes.context: Frustration with Q3 performance

quotes.quote: It's a good job first and foremost from the mechanics, big push obviously after the sprint race to get a slightly smoky car back in shape and get it out. I think more or less what we could ask for quite a big gap to the car in front to Pierre and P10.
quotes.context: Mechanics' effort after sprint damage

quotes.quote: I think honestly that's pretty much everything we had. We had an issue yesterday which put us out in Q1, but even if we'd got through, I think this is about where we would have been.
quotes.context: Maximizing limited car performance

quotes.quote: I prefer to be P14 leaving one or two tens in the table than 17 doing perfect laps like in China and Suzuka. So, I'll take that and we will make sure that we keep improving as a team.
quotes.context: Progress compared to previous races

quotes.quote: We improved quite a lot from this morning to now and compared to yesterday. I think it was a good step forward that we made with the car. Unfortunately, I hit the wall a little bit, so I had the steering not very straight.
quotes.context: Car improvement despite wall contact

quotes.quote: From the first lap I didn't feel as comfortable as Sprint Quali yesterday. Obviously I've been on the back foot with mileage. I've come here as a rookie, it's my first time and we've had quite a challenging weekend.
quotes.context: Rookie struggles with limited mileage

quotes.quote: I think there was more performance in the car, to be honest, but we're struggling with the gearbox the whole qualifying. It was very harsh up-shifts and very random down-shifts as well.
quotes.context: Gearbox issues limiting performance

quotes.quote: I did quite a bit of changes and I think on these weekends, if you do too many sometimes it doesn't work out and I felt like we took a step back. I lost my second round due to pressing the wrong button from my side.
quotes.context: Setup changes and driver error

quotes.quote: It's a bit weird. I feel like we should have won the race out there today. At least we could have had more of a fight post the stop. I just didn't get that chance again. And Kimmy drove a good race, so it's hats off to him, honestly. He did a good race and never gave me an opportunity to get close again.
quotes.context: Finishing second behind Antonelli

quotes.quote: I think it was a reasonably good race. Couple moments that weren't my finest, but to come away with the podium's obviously great. I think given the toughness of the race and having to overtake, I think third was the most we could do.
quotes.context: Happy with podium finish

quotes.quote: It's a funny old place and it's been a funny old weekend. I just lost the rear and then of course I tried to recover or like try to minimize the damage by doing that 360. Then we opted to go early onto the hard compound and I think now in hindsight after the race it was probably a bit too long, it was just too difficult to keep the tires alive.
quotes.context: Struggling after turn two spin

quotes.quote: Very disappointed with myself. The last lap mistake is obviously all on me and it cost us a P3 or a P4. Mistakes happen, but in the last lap of the race like that, it's frustrating and not the level where I shall be at.
quotes.context: Last lap mistake costing podium

quotes.quote: I think if the car was in one piece, I felt that car was pretty good on the laps to the grid. So I felt like we would have been more competitive. I got held up at the beginning when Max spun and was in the wrong position for that and then obviously the damage that I got after that then I was just I had nothing.
quotes.context: Damage limiting his race performance

quotes.quote: Really happy. It's been a very good weekend since the start. We've been up there from free practice without knowing the track. The team done a very big effort to bring new parts for the cars, bring upgrades, new chassis. It's been very hectic in the factory in this break, but very useful and very proud to have got that performance back.
quotes.context: Pleased with upgrades and points finish

quotes.quote: We've anticipated probably a more challenging one given that we didn't bring any upgrades on the car. We finished very close to the points. Not close enough, but also the race didn't really go in favor. I got very unlucky on Lap one. I fell back and also in the stops lost a bit of time as well there.
quotes.context: Just missing out on points

quotes.quote: Honestly struggled a bit in the first few laps. Struggled a lot for grip on the medium. But then as soon as we put the hard on, I felt much better. It's still very early in the season. I'm still missing mileage this weekend. So stuff to work on.
quotes.context: Tire struggles and learning curve

quotes.quote: Performance is what it is. We are in a tough moment but we finished the race with both cars for the very first time in this year. So yeah, I think there are some progress on the reliability side and vibrations as I said yesterday are fixed now.
quotes.context: Reliability progress despite tough performance

quotes.quote: I just went into the last corner and when I braked, lost the gearbox and I went to neutral so I basically had no gears and I couldn't stop. It's not something I've had before. Obviously it's quite a big issue for us and it's what meant we had to retire the car. But it's a shame because it's obviously taken out Pierre as well.
quotes.context: Gearbox failure causing collision with Gasly

quotes.quote: The lap was quite bad to be fair. The session was not clean at all. I did a mistake in SQ2 and that threw me off a little bit. Then I decided to go for lap one on soft without doing prep and yeah, tires were a bit cold and it was just a messy session, but still P2 and very close, so the potential is definitely there.
quotes.context: Reflecting on messy qualifying session

quotes.quote: Not a good surprise I think after this morning we were a little bit worried about how far off we were and more just the lack of confidence in the car. But we made some tweaks, we changed some things and seems to make a good improvement, so happy with third.
quotes.context: Discussing improvements made to the car

quotes.quote: It's probably the best qualifying session we had for some time and just really great work with the engineers. Set up changes, the car felt really fantastic from P1 and we made just subtle changes going into quali.
quotes.context: Praising engineering work on setup

quotes.quote: I haven't been at all at ease with the car. I'm really struggling with the brakes on my side of the garage for some reason. In the brakes, I get into the corners hoping that I don't end up going straight.
quotes.context: Explaining brake issues affecting performance

quotes.quote: My feeling in the car was not very good. I was struggling a lot with just the ride of the car, all over the bumps. Couldn't put my foot down. Actually, my feet were even flying off the pedals.
quotes.context: Describing car handling difficulties over bumps

quotes.quote: The pace was better than expected. I think the team have done a mega job. Obviously, we brought this new upgrade. It seems to be working well. I'm happy with myself. Obviously, it's a very difficult track to come to as a rookie, especially on a sprint weekend.
quotes.context: Pleased with rookie performance and upgrades

quotes.quote: These first few races have been good. It's been a very challenging and troubling P1 for me, especially. We had a couple of issues there, so it wasn't the best of preps, but nevertheless you put the best car that you have on track and it's been quite all right.
quotes.context: Reflecting on challenging practice session

quotes.quote: The lap was good, but not the mega lap of quali. The track was tricky, it was very dirty and everyone was just struggling with tire temps. I did a decent lap, but not enough to go through Q3.
quotes.context: Explaining narrow miss on Q3 qualification

quotes.quote: I went out a bit then and the car broke down, so it was not a great session, specially in a track that was so dirty. This generation of cars, specially in sprint weekends, you need to get the laps in and I didn't get them in free practice.
quotes.context: Frustrated by mechanical issues limiting practice

quotes.quote: We got extremely lucky this morning. It was a hard hit. I'm probably going to feel it tomorrow. But we just damaged the front wing which was the best out of what could have happened really.
quotes.context: Relieved after escaping major crash damage

quotes.quote: We expected the new upgrade to be a bit more easy to put on track and we expected it to be straight away a step forward and that hasn't really been the case. We really struggled in free practice and didn't really learn much.
quotes.context: Disappointed with new upgrade performance

quotes.quote: Very difficult day on my side. I've had some things that were a bit out of place on the brakes in general and on track like this where all breaking points are quite bumpy, brake confidence is costing me quite a bit. But on top of that, Lewis is extremely strong on this track. So I've been a bit playing catch-up so far.
quotes.context: Struggling with brake confidence issues

quotes.quote: In the race, I felt like my race pace was very strong. So I'm optimistic for tomorrow, even though it might rain. But for qualifying this afternoon, I'll just hope to fix the brake confidence I've had struggles with this weekend.
quotes.context: Optimistic about race pace despite struggles

quotes.quote: Mid annoying because we were so close to a point. On hindsight I think we were really strong in terms of pace and degradation with old medium versus new mediums around me and new hards. I think we were really strong and the pace was clearly a step in front of the others but it's a shame that we couldn't score that point.
quotes.context: Disappointed to miss out on points

quotes.quote: We learned that we are still struggling with the start. So it's something we need to work to fix that as we are, but it's compromising completely our race. If I'm very honest, we start and then we drop four, five, six positions and then we need to recover.
quotes.context: Struggling with race starts

quotes.quote: We decided last night to break the parc fermé and try a few things on the setup. We saw, having taken a deeper dive into the data, some characteristics and some behaviors of the car that were very unexpected. So we tried to find the root cause and take a step back on setup.
quotes.context: Breaking parc fermé to address car issues

quotes.quote: It felt great. It was a really tough qualifying. Conditions changed a lot today. It was much cooler. The track temperature in the order of about 15° and just couldn't get the tires working and we made some changes to the car to compensate. This wasn't comfortable. I needed to adjust my driving style to compensate. Needed to adjust my outlaps to get the tires more balanced front to rear. And just finally nailed it on the last lap. So that was so rewarding.
quotes.context: Securing pole position in qualifying

quotes.quote: Same gap as yesterday. So yeah, obviously it's a pity, but I think overall was still a decent session. Was very tricky to get tires in the right window, but we try our best and that last lap I finished it and I was a bit, you know, not too sure and just they felt like I wish I had another run.
quotes.context: Qualifying behind his Mercedes teammate

quotes.quote: My last lap was good to be honest. But Lewis went off ahead of me and then I got a load of dirt and mud in my face and on the tires. So I lost a little bit and then I lost because I didn't have the slipstream and you know half a tenth one tenth around the whole lap but half a tenth one puts me one position higher and not far from pole right.
quotes.context: Explaining narrow margin to pole position

quotes.quote: Yeah, it wasn't bad, I think. Just a little bit tricky in a few areas, but overall, I was pretty happy. And yeah, we got closer to Mercedes, but not quite enough. So I know we tried our best. I think we were definitely able to put a bit more pressure on, but they've still got the ultimate pace over us.
quotes.context: Assessing McLaren's pace versus Mercedes

quotes.quote: I was feeling great up until the last lap. Yeah, basically I did a good prep. I came out the last corner to start the lap and didn't get the deployment on and by the time I realized I was down into turn one, I was down two tenths. So and then I called some of it back, but then yeah, I had that wide moment.
quotes.context: Explaining deployment issue on final lap

quotes.quote: Everything is super confusing. You honestly I come out of this qualifying, I have no idea actually what was going on just because of every lap you have other issues. You have more clipping, less clipping, sudden decrease in speed. And then besides that, I think what we did with the car was maybe not fantastic. It helped one area and then made another area worse. So it's just going in circles.
quotes.context: Describing confusing qualifying session performance

quotes.quote: Mistake on the first run of Q3 and yeah, I couldn't really have a good reference heading into that final lap and I was kind of overdriving it and yeah, it's really a shame cuz it's the first time this year we've had such a good car and I had to kind of throw it all away because I didn't do a good job.
quotes.context: Regretting mistake in Q3 first run

quotes.quote: It was actually which is even more of a disastrous weekend. Honestly, it's been one, if not the worst weekend of my career. Since F1, I haven't had one lap where I could feel the car. I just felt like I'm going to put it into the wall in every single corner I do just because the tires were completely out of the window today.
quotes.context: Describing worst weekend of his career

quotes.quote: The weekend's gone well so far. Obviously after sprint I tried to really make a point to not get complacent cuz things can change very easily as we've seen before in these sprint weekends. But again, we seem to have good pace. The team did a really good job. They've given me a car that I've been comfortable with all weekend. Happy to have another Q3.
quotes.context: Pleased with Q3 appearance and pace

quotes.quote: Today it's been a perfect day. It's been very good both sessions a race and the quality now. Race very strong very good pace close to the points and now again going flat out from the start to the end and setting very good laps. I had confidence in the car and yeah I'm very pleased with the result.
quotes.context: Celebrating strong qualifying performance

quotes.quote: We missed it obviously by three tenths to be honest. That was what we had. Clean laps, squeezed it as hard as I could. Obviously always on the edge here. But pretty happy with what we've done just now. But obviously, yeah, slightly disappointing maybe that it's not into Q3, but I think we need to see bigger picture.
quotes.context: Missing Q3 by narrow margin

quotes.quote: A little bit disappointed, I think. The cars are obviously very quick this weekend. So it's a shame not to put both cars in Q3 where they honestly should be, but yeah, the first laps this weekend I done in sort of mode one and qualifying and on a soft tire. So just trying to sort of catch back up a little bit.
quotes.context: Disappointed not to reach Q3

quotes.quote: Struggled a bit more today in quali than yesterday. I would say yesterday I just felt a bit more comfortable and today not really. Was really struggling with a few points. But yeah, I think was just not the cleanest qualifying. I think actually very tough. But anyway, it's not that we could have done much more than this.
quotes.context: Struggling more than in sprint qualifying

quotes.quote: I think we underdelivered a bit. I think we should have been on the top 12 with a good lap. I think the car today could do a 1:39, 1:40 which is top 12. Unfortunately in Q2 run two for whatever reason we need to analyze why I didn't feel good with the front tire and we lost two or three tenths in sector one versus my best lap.
quotes.context: Believing team underdelivered in qualifying

quotes.quote: Again very tough and it's been a weekend of finding uncovering new limitations every time we get in the car. So this time I think we finally found ourselves with a better through corner balance. And now we're finding out that with a bit of confidence, you can finally push the entries and now I'm locking fronts in every single time I try.
quotes.context: Discovering new car limitations throughout weekend

quotes.quote: It was the ultimate chance that last lap really. I mean we completely changed the car just before qualifying. So it was not easy to get a proper feel really with that last qualifying. You only have three or four laps to get used to everything. So trying to figure out where the grip is was better, what the grip was worth with the updated car and yeah, it was just very difficult to put everything together.
quotes.context: Struggling after major car changes before qualifying

quotes.quote: Oh man, it's the happiest day of my days at Ferrari so far. So, feels great to be able to put the Ferrari on the podium and to get my first second place with the team as well in the main race. And it's my second podium as well. I'm just elated and so proud of the team for working so hard.
quotes.context: Celebrating his first Ferrari podium

quotes.quote: I finally have the engineering team that I've been working towards. I think our car is great. The guys did a fantastic job over winter to get the car where it is. And I understand I think I understand it a lot better. I'm much more comfortable with it.
quotes.context: Praising Ferrari's car development work

quotes.quote: It was a horrible horrible weekend. As I said yesterday, I had already said it was probably the most difficult weekend so far of my Formula 1 career. I finished a race now and I can definitely say it's the most difficult weekend of my Formula 1 career so far.
quotes.context: Struggling with car setup difficulties

quotes.quote: The only positive of a weekend like this is that I've got Lewis in the same car and I can look at what he did this weekend and try to get answers on why I was just struggling so much.
quotes.context: Learning from teammate Lewis Hamilton

quotes.quote: Really proud. So I think we as a team we've done an amazing job to maximize everything out there with a very good start kept the position then of course it is not the best feeling when you get the positions of others people's issues but we've been up there all weekend we maximized I think every session what the car could do and yeah at the end we just brought the car home in P6 and a lot of points for the team.
quotes.context: Achieving his best ever finish

quotes.quote: Yeah, I must say I'm happy with the I'll call it damage limitation. So, you know, the whole weekend with all the struggles yeah, I'll I take these four points definitely. A very good weekend for the team as well six and eight so 12 points I think it's been a while since we scored that.
quotes.context: Satisfied with points after struggles

quotes.quote: At some point in the race we must have had really good pace because yeah after being almost a lap last after lap three I think to come back from the back of the field to P9 I think it's a very strong result for us.
quotes.context: Recovering from wrong tire strategy

quotes.quote: My mistake because I did the call of starting on inter when I took the decision 8 minutes to go the track was wet it was still raining yeah probably didn't know that it was going to stop within 5 minutes and there were going to be three formation laps that would dry out completely the track.
quotes.context: Explaining his tire choice error

quotes.quote: Honestly I feel like we didn't really deserve that today based on our performance but we'll take it. There's been other weekends where we've probably felt like we deserved a bit more and didn't get that. So swings and roundabouts but yeah generally it's been a really challenging weekend for us.
quotes.context: Reflecting on fortunate points finish

quotes.quote: The rush of adrenaline, oh my gosh. I was still shaking after one hour because the rush — I think these are the most intense qualifying sessions of the year. When it's about trying to polish those last two tenths, it's so difficult. You keep getting closer to the wall and it's just about fine margins. Max made our life very hard and he did incredible as well. Also Ferrari very quick, but big thanks to the team because the turnaround from yesterday was just immense.
quotes.context: Reflecting on intense Monaco qualifying session

quotes.quote: The changes that we made for sure helped. The car felt a little bit more together. Even though our weak sector is sector two — the curbs, the bumps — that's where we still lose out compared to some of our competitors. But overall it was a strong qualifying for us. I think heading into the weekend I would have definitely signed for this.
quotes.context: Assessing car improvements and qualifying result

quotes.quote: It's been a possible weekend. I've been on it all weekend and feeling great with my team and setup. When I was quickest yesterday I still had good performance left on track, so I felt positive. Then today it was a much harder day — the car's not been the same for some reason. Qualifying was really challenging. I can't say I'm happy with P3 because we should be fighting for P1, but I'll take it and try to do something with it.
quotes.context: Disappointed with P3 despite strong pace

quotes.quote: I'm very disappointed. It's been an incredibly tough weekend. On braking I just don't really know where to brake still. Getting to Q3 after FP1, FP2, FP3 makes it very very tricky for me. On my side of the garage it's been a very messy weekend. We had a lot of issues in Q3 as well — had to go out of the box much earlier. I knew I had two laps, I tried everything on the second lap, I didn't finish a lap and that's it.
quotes.context: Frustrated with messy qualifying and issues

quotes.quote: Mixed feelings because considering how bad yesterday was — I didn't do many laps and you need laps around here — getting P5 and being relatively competitive feels nice. But there was more obviously on the table. I think what Max did is what I wanted to accomplish, but I was struggling at the start of Q3 so I had a setback and it's not the best way to approach that final lap.
quotes.context: Mixed feelings about P5 qualifying result

quotes.quote: The last few races it's just been so challenging for me just to get the laps together. I remember at the first two races of the season every lap I did in practice or quali it was always P1 or P2. And now nothing's clicking. Got some ideas, but my driving style is just not working with the car at the moment.
quotes.context: Struggling to find form with the car

quotes.quote: Maybe there was a tiny bit more lap time out there, but I think we were going to be seventh no matter what today. We struggled with the balance all weekend. Yesterday and today the car has actually felt a little bit nicer, but we're just lacking grip compared to the others.
quotes.context: Accepting limited pace despite balance improvements

quotes.quote: I just had a lockup into turn 10. I was at 99.9% and it's hard to know that sometimes, and I went to 100% and paid the price. I feel like we got a lot of lap time out quite early on in qualifying but there just wasn't much more to come after that. We've been struggling all weekend, that's been very clear. I was 2/10 up in Q3 but even then I only would have been ahead of Oscar, so the gap to the others was still just too significant.
quotes.context: Explaining lockup and car's lack of pace

quotes.quote: Very, very happy. I'm full of adrenaline right now. I don't think we could have hoped for a better result — best of the rest behind the top four teams which are too competitive for us to mix with them. It wasn't easy to top the midfield. Q3 went all out and I'm so pleased the lap all came together. When I passed the line I could feel it was like I could not do any more, so I was very happy with it.
quotes.context: Thrilled with best of rest qualifying result

quotes.quote: We were struggling to make the first push after the build work so sector one was not quite there, but then the second half of the lap was good. I went for another push at the end and was improving but the tires don't hang on the whole lap. I tried really hard today, I hit the wall quite a few times — definitely tried to get everything out of it, so after yesterday it's a good result.
quotes.context: Reflecting on tire struggles and effort

quotes.quote: A bit frustrating but honestly the lap was out of control from turn one. It felt like I was going to hit a wall eventually. I was lucky it was minor but I was struggling a lot in qualifying, didn't feel comfortable with the car, felt very on the edge. That was probably the most uncomfortable I felt in a qualifying lap around Monaco and the wall tap did cost me P3.
quotes.context: Frustrated after wall tap cost him position

quotes.quote: Unfortunately I didn't do a very good lap in Q2. All the great things we did in Q1, with a very bad timing of that red flag that didn't allow me to post my fastest lap, and then I had to go straight back out on cold used tires and do a bonsai lap to get into Q2 — which was honestly one of the best laps I've done in my life given the circumstances. But my Q2 lap had one or two too many mistakes with a bit of front locking and I lost one or two tenths that cost me Q3.
quotes.context: Explaining red flag impact and Q2 mistakes

quotes.quote: Disappointed with Q2. The last run was a bit unlucky in terms of traffic — definitely not the best timing for that. We're just struggling to find more lap time and more grip when others were able to step it up and deliver a bit more. We didn't find it. Certainly disappointing because it was looking way more promising.
quotes.context: Disappointed with traffic and lack of pace

quotes.quote: I'm still really struggling to make the car do what I want. I'm struggling in general a little bit for balance and I disconnect from the car. Here it matters a lot because on the straights you need a lot of confidence and this weekend I didn't have it. We need to understand the reason — just a lot of low speed corners that have been tricky.
quotes.context: Struggling with car balance and confidence

quotes.quote: In Q1 I felt okay — I was up by quite a lot on the red flag lap and felt comfortable. But in Q2 I just wasn't able to deliver. The used tires were really cold on the first run and then on run two there was a lot of queuing in the last sector which meant I couldn't get the tires ready at all. I got to turn one and everything was just stone cold with no grip. I felt comfortable for the first time this weekend in Q1 but in Q2 we just weren't able to maximize on it.
quotes.context: Explaining cold tire issues in Q2

quotes.quote: I've not done a good job in qualifying. There was no need to take that many risks in Q1 — we knew we were on top 10 pace since FP1. I ended up taking a bit too many risks, I touched the wall and broke the suspension. The car was going to be all right to progress further, potentially up high in Q2 or into Q3.
quotes.context: Self-critical after wall contact ended session

quotes.quote: I feel like I say this every time, but it's just unlucky. Every single session something weird is happening. In my quick lap I got traffic by a good two and a half tenths, and then the red flag came and we didn't have enough time to warm up the tires — we only had an out lap but we need a prep lap. We did find some good performance from Friday to Saturday which was quite positive, but we'll never know now.
quotes.context: Frustrated by traffic and red flag bad luck

quotes.quote: I think we got the maximum out there with what we currently have. The window is very narrow — we were lacking the rears a lot all the way through qualifying. We did some changes and ended up locking too much of the fronts. I still managed to complete the lap which was already very tricky. The drivers can make a bit of a difference here in Monaco and I think we did that, but unfortunately it wasn't enough.
quotes.context: Extracting maximum from limited car window

quotes.quote: I'm really disappointed. This morning was a very unlucky moment — I was a bit off line with traffic on the left and picked up the dust and just lost it. The guys worked tirelessly to put the car back together and it was feeling so good. I was on for a lap that would have put me well within reach of Q2, in for the top 10, and then the red flag came. After the red flag I had no grip on the lap — we'd been doing preparation laps on the soft tire all weekend but this time we had to just go and push straight away without a prep lap.
quotes.context: Unlucky crash and red flag ruined qualifying

quotes.quote: I was hoping for a bit more but some gaps are getting maybe a bit smaller for us. We were ahead of Aston so that's something. It's been tough out there — I thought maybe this track could suit our car but we're struggling a lot with the ride of the car and obviously here you need a lot of compliance.
quotes.context: Struggling with car ride and compliance

quotes.quote: It was a tough weekend. We were hoping for a little bit better here around Monaco but yesterday in free practice we felt we were not in the pace and we had no confidence in the car on the braking and with the downshift. Tough tough weekend.
quotes.context: Lacking confidence in braking and downshift

quotes.quote: Not so nice to drive here when you have no grip and the car's not really hooked up. It's not such an enjoyable experience, but yeah, the Riviera, the weather's nice and the sun is shining so that's okay.
quotes.context: Wry comment on gripless car at Monaco

quotes.quote: I'm not only happy about the win. I'm really happy about the weekend, with how we progressed, how the team did an incredible turnaround. The car just changed so much and it gave me the confidence to push it.
quotes.context: Reflecting on his Monaco Grand Prix victory

quotes.quote: I inherited a car that wasn't really suited for me and something I didn't like. Whilst it was such a hard year in the background, we did a lot of work to develop, and sitting down with the engineers and telling them where I wanted to go. I begged Fred for certain changes and he moved heaven and earth for me, so for that I'm really grateful.
quotes.context: Discussing car development and team collaboration

quotes.quote: I just had to dig very deep. I thought it was going to be a stroll and in the end it started to be a bit of a nightmare race for me with all the issues I had to manage. The car with the driveability issues we had was becoming undrivable, but I managed to hold on and keep a decent place for the last three starts.
quotes.context: Describing his difficult Monaco race

quotes.quote: Much more than we could have ever imagined after yesterday. The timing of the red flag helped us out, but regardless I think we executed a really strong race. Points are scored on Sunday and everyone from trackside, Milton Keynes, fans, we've all done an amazing job.
quotes.context: Positive reaction to strong points finish

quotes.quote: Right now I'm just heartbroken. I don't know what to say. We all work so hard to get these moments and then when it gets taken away from you — the team said the right speed limiter, I put it way before the line on both times, and we cross the line in P3 in Monaco and in the end we get penalized and finish far away.
quotes.context: Devastated reaction to Monaco pit lane penalty

quotes.quote: I'm flat, beyond frustration, in a state of struggling to comprehend what is going on. The team told me there's nothing I did wrong in the pit lane — I pressed the limiter before the entry, I released it after the exit, but there was a software issue. A 5-second penalty, then we did a pit stop and didn't serve it, drive-through penalty, and I went from P3 to zero points.
quotes.context: Angry reaction to penalty and lost podium

quotes.quote: We were down on deployment and after 15 laps we were hemorrhaging lap time. I gave up a position to Arvid and I thought we'd done all of that for nothing and I was frustrated. Luckily we made it work — P8 is a great result for us and it's been maybe my best weekend so far this year.
quotes.context: Reflecting on deployment issues and team strategy

quotes.quote: For a change we got everything right this time. We took all the right calls regarding the strategy. I really struggled — we had an issue with the steering wheel for the whole weekend — but I did it for the guys because it was super tough. After 20 laps I thought I could not finish that race and we pushed through and got to the end with P9.
quotes.context: Satisfied with strategy and fighting through difficulties

quotes.quote: I had kind of had to avoid Esteban, I had to dive on the inside to not run into the back of him, ended up on the very inside in Lewis' corner at maximum lock, I couldn't turn more, and Carlos obviously comes around and we make contact. Very frustrating and disappointing.
quotes.context: Explaining contact with Sainz at restart

quotes.quote: It's a very good race pace. The few laps that I managed to push we showed some really serious race pace, but unfortunately at the restarts some people decided to risk everything and I was the victim of people being very overly optimistic. Every year around Monaco at turn six you need to lift and you're going to bump into the car in front, so it's difficult to see how with so much experience we're still able to do this kind of mistake and throw my race away.
quotes.context: Frustrated about contact ruining his race

quotes.quote: Yeah, extremely disappointed, sad, angry — a mix of negative emotions. The issues I've faced with my brakes have been impossible. I cannot do anything. The rear brakes was not working at all and the front delivered a lot more than what it shows, so that's what happened.
quotes.context: Describing brake issues that ended his race

quotes.quote: We have issues with the engine braking — every lap, every corner, the engine braking changes, some laps it's pushing me forward, some laps it's pulling me. On that corner it just pushed me forward and I went into the wall.
quotes.context: Explaining engine braking issue causing crash

quotes.quote: An amazing thing for the team — it was such a tricky race with the vibrations. At some point we thought about retiring the car because the vibrations were tremendous. We didn't give up, we stayed out, we kept pushing, and the race presented us with another opportunity and we went for it.
quotes.context: Praising team resilience despite car vibrations

quotes.quote: After such a nice weekend for us, you at least hope to be on the podium. When you retire basically straight away it's painful for everyone. I really felt good this whole weekend and to come away with zero points is probably even more painful.
quotes.context: Disappointed reaction to retirement from strong position

quotes.quote: More than just the pole, just how this whole weekend has panned out. Had a big reset after Monaco. It's been a really tough run of races for us for various different reasons. But just had a big reset with the team and every single lap we've done this week, every session, every lap, we've been in the top two positions.
quotes.context: Reflecting on pole position and weekend reset

quotes.quote: The first sector of the first lap was really good and it was looking like it was going to be something similar, but then the red flag came in and when I went back out on the used tire, I was just half a second off. That last lap, I went probably a little bit too deep into turn one, but managed to pull it off. These tires are so sensitive and what you do on the out lap is so critical to whether the tires are overheated or they stay in the perfect window with the grip.
quotes.context: Discussing his qualifying lap and tire management

quotes.quote: Even though I missed FP1, I think this weekend I didn't have enough pace on a single lap. I've been overdriving the car and conditions are very tricky, very slippery, very hot, and tires just been running away a little bit from me. Just struggling to extract the maximum out of them for the whole lap.
quotes.context: Explaining struggles with pace and tires

quotes.quote: I don't think you can expect a lot more. I had the red flag on my first lap into turn one and I think maybe that lap was even better than my second lap. The second lap is just my only chance to put a lap time on the board and I just can't take quite the same risks in a few of the corners as I did on lap one, so we were just unfortunate out there today.
quotes.context: Reflecting on red flag impact in qualifying

quotes.quote: Qualifying went quite a bit better than expected. The gap was a lot smaller. Looking back to P5 it looks decent, but actually we had a really good opportunity for P3 as well, but somehow in my final sector I just started sliding too much. I went into qualifying thinking that we would be miles off and just be P7, P8, but this was promising.
quotes.context: Surprised by competitive qualifying result

quotes.quote: I mean, I don't even know how we are three tenths off pole because I've been a second off the whole time, so that's a bit surprising. And being so close to P3 is a bit disappointing.
quotes.context: Surprised by closeness to pole position

quotes.quote: It was a good lap until the last sector. I'm not really sure where all the time went away, but yeah, until that point it was strong. Obviously very, very close margins out there. It's going to be a race of car pace throughout a stint, not just over a lap, so let's see what we've got.
quotes.context: Assessing qualifying lap and race prospects

quotes.quote: To be honest, it's been a trickier day today than yesterday overall. We had a good start to the weekend and then just a difficult end to yesterday. Finding the balance this morning and then honestly just put one really good lap together in Q2, so yeah, very happy. We're in a good place for tomorrow.
quotes.context: Reflecting on a tricky but positive qualifying

quotes.quote: Q1 actually my first lap I had a moment in turn three, which immediately our tires are hot and kind of has an effect on the rest of the lap, so we were not safe enough with that lap. Had to do the second run and use the second set, which then leaves you only with one new set in Q2, so that was a bit tricky, a bit hairy, but we stayed cool and made it stick.
quotes.context: Describing Q1 moment and tire strategy challenge

quotes.quote: I just feel ashamed of not putting everything together on what was a very positive weekend so far. The feeling is back and I'm still optimistic for tomorrow, but I should be starting higher up and I don't because of a mistake of mine. I feel ashamed for disappointing so many people that are supporting us.
quotes.context: Expressing disappointment over qualifying mistake

quotes.quote: No deployment into turn one. When I come out of the last corner the engine didn't go, so I was two seconds off down before T1. A bit of a shame considering I think we were very much in the fight for Q3. It was always what, P6 after run one. So to go out in Q2 is pretty disappointing.
quotes.context: Explaining engine deployment issue in Q2
