quotes.quote: It was quite a messy session with quite a lot of things to review, definitely harder than yesterday. I'm sure we'll dig in, and still right outside the points I think we can give a good fight tomorrow for P9 and P10.
quotes.context: Reviewing a difficult qualifying session

quotes.quote: I was really confused because the feeling was much better in the car and I was more confident compared to yesterday and even this morning, but the lap time was even harder to come by. I struggled more to get it out of the car, so it was quite a confusing one.
quotes.context: Puzzled by gap between feeling and lap time

quotes.quote: I really enjoyed the process. Yesterday was more like still in a fresh car not sure where the limit is, but I started to understand more from the sprint race and was able to push more. Very close to Q3 — honestly it was like a dream, it was super fun.
quotes.context: Enjoying learning process in new car

quotes.quote: I felt like especially the best I've done all year, just glad to be able to get into some form of rhythm. We made some changes between this morning and qualifying and it was a little bit like nothing's going to make it worse, and we made it a lot better. Car feels way better so hopefully it will help us tomorrow.
quotes.context: Encouraged by car improvements before qualifying

quotes.quote: Not having a great start for whatever reason, so we need to review some things. The whole of yesterday and today, the right side of the grid seemed to be better starters than the left, for some reason, and this is what we learned from yesterday and it was clear again today, so we need to understand why.
quotes.context: Discussing poor start and grid side differences

quotes.quote: Disappointed because we've led most of half of the race, but on that last stint on the hard tire something just didn't feel right with the car. Just had really little confidence and the pace was not there, so of course it's a shame because I really believed in it. P2 is the maximum that we could have done.
quotes.context: Reflecting on losing race lead late

quotes.quote: I come away from this weekend as a whole satisfied. It's been my best weekend for quite a while. That first VSC towards the end came at a tough point because it gave Lewis that opportunity to get a free pit stop. P3 was probably a fair result.
quotes.context: Satisfied with weekend despite VSC timing

quotes.quote: Gave it absolutely everything today and it's so close at the top. Mercedes are gaining like 4/10 of a second just on the straight, so that's really hard to capture everywhere else. It just shows we've got a really good car, and if we can somehow improve our power unit and get a bit closer to them, hopefully we can be even more in the mix.
quotes.context: Discussing pace gap to Mercedes on straights

quotes.quote: I think we've lacked a little bit of luck today. The virtual safety car wasn't really the best timing for us — if anything, it was the worst. Before the break I had two or three races where luck seemed to be by my side, and at one point you get the other side of the coin. But the pace I think was strong, and I think eventually we are losing today's race because of qualifying yesterday.
quotes.context: Reflecting on bad VSC timing and qualifying

quotes.quote: It was a pretty lonely race for me, honestly. I just struggled to match the guys in front today. I knew after yesterday that we were behind them and I feel like yesterday was not bad in qualifying. But I probably didn't expect it to be that hard — we really struggled to match the front guys.
quotes.context: Struggling to match pace of leaders

quotes.quote: I'm very happy for the team. They nailed all the decisions today — the strategy was the right one, the starting tire was the right one. The car was performing well with very low tire deg today, so I'm happy for the team. Hopefully we keep this momentum into the next few races.
quotes.context: Praising team strategy and car performance

quotes.quote: I did as much as I can and I definitely enjoyed the race today. It was a shame that I'm missing the points very closely, but overall it was pretty fun. I had some overtaking, which is what I miss a lot, and yeah, thanks to the team for helping me get up to speed this fast. Unforgettable memories in 2026 so far.
quotes.context: Enjoying race despite narrowly missing points

quotes.quote: In the end Max lost it, then he came across the track and there was debris everywhere. I couldn't really see anything. I think the penalty is a bit harsh — it took me out of the race, basically. But the pace was really good and from after that onwards I'm actually quite proud of my race. It's probably one of my best races in Formula 1 from a pace point of view.
quotes.context: Reacting to penalty after Verstappen crash incident

quotes.quote: It was a very good start, one of the best starts of the year, and then it was a pity — a very harsh penalty compromised the whole of our race. It's quite tricky to manage in those situations when there is a piece of car everywhere flying around and you have to make a decision. I was making my pass and it was clearly much more dangerous to slam on the brakes in the middle of the straight on the water and on the banking.
quotes.context: Defending his actions after receiving penalty

quotes.quote: I don't want to go too much into details, but we just need to understand some stuff that happened today and we move on. I had a few start problems today that almost made me not manage to run out of the grid box, but I appreciate the work of the team — they were really on it to make it happen and fix everything.
quotes.context: Discussing start problems and race issues

quotes.quote: Very difficult race. We've been scrubbing for P15 and P16 all weekend. When I went to defend, a big bump in the braking into turn one surprised me and I triggered a massive front lock, and without wanting to I took Alex with me, which is the last thing you want to do with a teammate. Apologies for that and we will move on as a team.
quotes.context: Apologizing for collision with teammate Albon

quotes.quote: We picked too early on the first stop and came up behind a train of seven cars. I think we were afraid that Fernando was going to undercut us, but by picking too early we basically spent the second stint stuck behind a train of cars. I really do think points were possible today, so yeah, frustrating.
quotes.context: Frustrated by early pit stop strategy call

quotes.quote: I had a hydraulic issue. We're still looking more in detail but it's quite a few DNFs now in a row which is not ideal. I don't think we had any reliability issues this year so far, so obviously it's the first one. It's been a PU issue that we need to look into — both cars had issues so we couldn't complete the race.
quotes.context: Explaining DNF due to hydraulic and PU issues
